Heat Resistant Welding Gloves

<!--Product Code:--> 021300302211010

  • Description

Heat Resistant Leather only at palm can resist more than 100 deg Celsius, Cow Split Leather on front cuff, Cow Split Leather on back, Heat resistant Wool Liner on palm & back, Denim Liner on front & back cuff, Aramid Thread, Wing Thumb, Four Tips.

Available gloves sizing :

Product Detail: 

Heat Resistant Welding Gloves Key Features:

Heat Resistant Leather (Palm): The palm of the gloves is made from specially treated heat resistant leather, providing excellent protection against high temperatures. This ensures that your hands remain safe from intense heat and sparks during welding and other heat-intensive tasks.

Cow Split Leather (Front Cuff & Back): The front cuff and back of the gloves feature durable cow split leather. This material adds robustness and flexibility, offering an additional layer of protection while enhancing the gloves' overall durability.

Heat Resistant Liner (Palm & Back): Inside the gloves, a heat resistant wool liner is strategically placed on the palm and back to enhance protection against high temperatures. This liner ensures your hands stay cool and protected even during prolonged exposure to intense heat.

Denim Liner (Front & Back Cuff): For added comfort and durability, the gloves include a denim liner on the front and back cuff. This soft, breathable lining adds an extra layer of protection and ensures a comfortable fit, reducing the risk of sweating and discomfort during extended use.

Aramid Thread: The gloves are stitched with aramid thread, known for its superior heat resistance and strength. This durable stitching ensures that the seams remain intact even under extreme conditions, providing reliable protection and longevity.

Wing Thumb Design: The ergonomic wing thumb design enhances flexibility and dexterity, allowing for a better grip and easier movement. This feature ensures that you can handle tools and materials with precision and ease.

Four Tips: Reinforced tips on the fingers provide extra durability and protection, enhancing the gloves' resistance to wear and tear and ensuring long-lasting performance.

Versatile Applications:

Heat and Welding Applications: These gloves are specifically designed for high-temperature environments, making them ideal for welding, metalworking, and other heat-intensive tasks. The combination of heat resistant leather and cow split leather ensures maximum protection against heat and flames.

General High-Temperature Work: Beyond welding, these gloves are suitable for any job involving high temperatures. Whether you’re working in a forge, handling hot materials, or performing maintenance in high-heat environments, these gloves provide the necessary protection.

Product Specifications

Material: Heat resistant leather on the palm, cow split leather on the front cuff and back

Liner: Heat resistant wool liner on the palm and back, denim liner on the front and back cuff

Thread: Aramid thread for high heat resistance and durability

Design Features: Wing thumb for enhanced dexterity, four tips for reinforced protection

Color: Natural leather tones with durable stitching and reinforced tips

Care Instructions:

To maintain the quality and performance of Our Premium Heat Resistant Leather Welding Gloves, follow these care instructions:

Cleaning: Gently brush off any debris or dust. If necessary, wipe with a damp cloth and mild soap. Avoid soaking the gloves or using harsh chemicals.

Drying: Allow the gloves to air dry naturally, away from direct heat sources and sunlight. Do not wring or tumble dry.

Storage: Store the gloves in a cool, dry place when not in use. Avoid crushing or folding to maintain their shape and integrity.
